Open [Folio Job Board](./index.html) in a browser. It works offline and saves orders in the current browser profile on the shop computer.

The board includes all three requested orders. Click a job to edit its due date and time, move it between stages, or record a partial pickup. Outstanding counts update after each pickup, and overdue jobs stay highlighted until all copies are collected.

**Print daily queue** groups outstanding jobs by the next staff action and lists the earliest deadline first. The sample dates use the next Tuesday, including today if applicable, and the following Wednesday.

I verified the workflow, pickup calculations, overdue handling, and persistence with automated checks. Browser launch was blocked in this environment, so the print layout remains visually unverified. [Shop instructions](./README.txt)
